tells.1: Compatibility warning comes after the step it is meant to precede, inside a flat “To reseal…” template with even cadence.
tells.2: Same template and misplaced caveat as version 1; the curly apostrophe is the only change and reads processed rather than typed.
tells.3: Infinitive “To reseal…” opener and one smoothly even instructional block.
tells.5: “Got a leaky tent seam? It’s an easy fix” hook, and “Before you start” lands after the brushing step it should precede.

reason: Version 4 reads most like a skilled how-to writer: usable order, plain verbs, and no template cadence, so that is the one I would publish. Version 5 is voicey but the easy-fix hook and out-of-order caveat feel performed, while 1–3 stay in the same smooth instructional mold.
